title: Why did Sanjna become a horse?
hooks: Suraj ki aag se bachne ke liye devi ko ghodi banna pada!
Sanjna ne Surya ka tej sahan nahi kiya, chupke se ban gayi ghodi.
Kya aapko pata hai Surya dev ko ghoda kyun banna pada tha?
hook_why: Opens with the striking conversational hook about escaping the sun's heat by turning into a mare, written in natural spoken Hindi without bookish words.
metaphor: The horse form as a living shield against Surya's unbearable radiance — a divine adaptation that turns flight into penance and union.

cast.Surya: Radiant golden deity with four arms, riding a chariot pulled by seven horses, crown of sun rays, warm golden aura.
cast.Sanjna: Beautiful goddess with lotus eyes, golden complexion, wearing red saree with gold ornaments, calm expression.
cast.Chhaya: Shadowy duplicate of Sanjna, same form but dark grey silhouette, subtle divine glow.
cast.AshwiniKumaras: Twin youthful gods with horse heads, golden armor, holding medicinal herbs.

scenes.vo: Aapki kya rai hai is par? Comments mein batao.

caption:
Surya's heat forced Sanjna into a mare's form — a divine escape that became a penance. 🐎✨
The Vishnu Purana reveals how adaptation turns crisis into creation.
What would you have done in Sanjna's place?

claims.claim: Sanjna, daughter of Vishwakarma, married Surya.
Sanjna could not bear Surya's intense radiance and created a shadow double named Chhaya.
Sanjna transformed into a mare and performed penance in the forest.
Surya discovered the deception, became a stallion, and united with her, producing the Ashwini Kumaras and Revanta.
Sanjna later returned to Surya and they resumed their married life.
